name: Haunted by Shadows of You
overview:
Qin Jian Lu fell in love at first sight with the aloof Buddhist Xie Fan Sheng. After six years of crazy love, she finally got what she wanted and became Mrs. Xie by all means. However, she has not been able to consummate her marriage after two years of marriage. By chance, Qin Jian Lu discovered that her husband had a deformed obsession with his non-blood-related sister, Xie Tang Li.

Xie Fan Sheng's unconditional indulgence and partiality towards Xie Tang Li made Qin Jian Lu completely heartbroken. She signed a divorce agreement and went to Germany to start a new relationship with Shen Mo Yan, who had been secretly in love with her for ten years. However, Xie Fan Sheng suddenly discovered that Qin Jian Lu was the one he loves...

(Source: Chinese = iQiyi || Translation = Google Translate)
